nqdir.description: The directory where lock files and job output reside. Each NQDIR is considered a separate queue.

nqdonedir.description: Directory where job output is moved to after successful execution. Must be on the same filesystem as NQDIR. Leave empty to disable.

nqfaildir.description: Directory where job output is moved to after unsuccessful execution. Must be on the same filesystem as NQDIR. Leave empty to disable.
